verdict.rationale: Docs describe delegating end-to-end feature work — Droid analyzes the codebase, proposes and applies changes, runs in isolated worktrees, and Missions let you define features/milestones/success criteria before code is written, with autonomous execution via CLI or app. Test writing/execution isn't explicitly called out as a distinct deliverable, but bash-mode/CI execution (droid exec) implies running and fixing tests as part of the loop. Missing for 10: explicit first-party mention of test-writing as part of the feature workflow, and independent/hands-on verification of end-to-end success.
